text: The reland's Hub and test imports both name accountcreation, matching the build registration. Its forced-state task appears after finding-config cancellation and ends by clicking the nested header close button, awaiting close and asserting the dialog is closed. The dummy module and build file retain the original output blobs. Earlier dummy-state and repeated-reference findings remain separate reused claims. These are exact source/test deltas, not a diagnosed loader failure or a reproduced backout fix.
